scope: Metadata for the220 new finite conditional certificates. Existing root and original proof identities remain unchanged.
historicalModelMeaning: For these entries the historical model digest identifies the frozen source application context. It does not assert that this model discovered the whole root proof.
discoveryModelMeaning: Null means model-free discovery. A composite value distinguishes model-free root construction from configured neural models in original source-leaf discovery. Neural evaluations and finite rule proofs are separate evidence.
